t_p1_05: T-P1-05 consumes this artifact for Rust-tcp vs native / vs TS-tcp turn / model-iter / stream-chunk attribution. This PR does not write go-nogo.

notes.one: streamChunkChars=1 means one Unicode code point per post-prefix chunk, not the whole body.
notes.fiveHundredShortBody: If mock body length < 500, chars=500 yields STREAM_PREFIX + one remainder (same shape as the default omitted-field path). Variants pad q so body > 500.
notes.defaultPath: sidecar_live_model_stream omits streamChunkChars: STREAM_PREFIX + one whole-body remainder (2 deltas), including when the body is an empty string.
notes.firstChunkInterval: stream_chunk_ms[0] (prefix → first body chunk) includes mock model latency (live-stream modelMs: 200). Exclude interval[0] when attributing harness / Gateway / sidecar forwarding.
notes.nChunksSources: n_chunks is the harness yield count (model.stream state=chunks, or planned prefix+body slices). perf_n_chunks is the Gateway-observed assistant_text_delta count from the perf snapshot; observed n_text_deltas is user.output count. They may differ if Gateway/sidecar coalesces deltas.
notes.plannedOracle: In planned mode firstDeltaBeforeProviderCompletion and outputContainsSTREAM_PREFIX are null (not evaluated). Live --run-gateway fills them from the trace.
